title: Coherence-Guided Pyramid Self-Contrastive Disentanglement for Ultrasound Imaging via Single-Shot Test-Time Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.12567v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The inherent electronic noise, side lobes, and speckle noise complicate clinical interpretation of ultrasound images. Conventional denoising methods rely on explicit noise assumptions that may underperform in composite noise conditions. Learning-based methods are usually pretrained in a limited image domain and face inevitable domain shift in complex \textit{in vivo} environments. This study proposes a computational ultrasound imaging pipeline with a Pyramid Self-Contrastive Disentanglement (PSCD) model. We generalize the explicit IQ signal coherence to a learnable latent space and formulate it as a contrastive critic to implicitly disentangle the received IQ signals into a coherent anatomy space and an incoherent noise space. Clean IQ signals for B-mode image formation are estimated from the anatomy space exclusively. translated_title: 基于单次测试时训练的相干性引导金字塔自对比解耦超声成像方法
translated_abstract: 超声图像中固有的电子噪声、旁瓣和斑点噪声使其临床解读变得复杂。传统去噪方法依赖于显式的噪声假设，在复合噪声条件下可能表现不佳。基于学习的方法通常仅在有限的图像域中预训练，在复杂的体内环境中面临不可避免的域偏移问题。本研究提出了一种包含金字塔自对比解耦模型的计算超声成像流程。我们将显式的IQ信号相干性泛化到可学习的潜在空间，并将其构建为对比判别器，从而将接收到的IQ信号隐式解耦为相干的解剖空间和非相干的噪声空间。用于B模式图像重建的干净IQ信号仅从解剖空间中进行估计。我们首先将PSCD应用于合成孔径超声，其中孔径到孔径的代理任务约束了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出金字塔自对比解耦（PSCD）模型，将显式IQ信号相干性泛化为可学习的对比判别器，把超声信号隐式解耦为解剖空间与噪声空间，并结合单次测试时训练策略，实现无需显式噪声假设且能应对域偏移的超声图像去噪。
